::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Feb 13th [1862-3]  
**From:** Otterbourn  
**Manuscript:** MS Harry Ransom Humanities Research Center, University of Texas, Austin
:::

My dear [Miss Holbeche](people/person_2078.qmd),
I send some stamps from a Miss Murray at Brighton for your poor blind friend, and by the same post your 13 copies of the [Last Heartsease Leaves](cmy_books/cmybook_45.qmd), with many thanks  for your kindness in disposing of them, I hope they will not prove so small as to be very disappointing

With many thanks
yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** The letter is evidently addressed to the author of 'Blindness: Its Trials and Blessings' *MP* (July 1861) 91-99.
